title: Natation
description: Allure/100 m et détail des longueurs depuis les tables core disponibles (core.activity, core.sport, core.swim_length). Le SWOLF est volontairement OMIS : il exigerait la distance d'une longueur de bassin, qui n'est stockée nulle part dans le schéma (core.swim_length n'a pas de colonne distance_m ni length_m) — l'inventer serait une hypothèse non vérifiable sur l'installation du bassin.

options.content: **SWOLF non affiché** : cette métrique nécessite la distance d'une longueur de bassin, absente de `core.swim_length` (aucune colonne `distance_m`/`length_m`). L'allure ci-dessous est calculée au niveau de la séance entière depuis `core.activity.distance_m` et `core.activity.swim_time_s`, qui sont, eux, réellement mesurés.

panels.title: Séances de natation
panels.description: Allure /100 m = swim_time_s / (distance_m / 100), calculée depuis core.activity (colonnes réellement mesurées, cf. COMMENT ON COLUMN core.activity.swim_time_s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.local_date AS "Date", a.name AS "Séance", a.distance_m AS "Distance (m)", a.swim_time_s AS "Temps de nage (s)", CASE WHEN a.distance_m > 0 AND a.swim_time_s > 0 THEN (a.swim_time_s / (a.distance_m / 100.0)) END AS "Allure /100 m (s)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY a.local_date DESC

SELECT a.local_date::timestamp AS time, (a.swim_time_s / (a.distance_m / 100.0)) AS "Allure /100 m (s)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.distance_m > 0 AND a.swim_time_s > 0 AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY a.local_date

panels.title: Longueurs par séance
panels.description: core.swim_length est la seule granularité fine en piscine, où core.sample est vide (COMMENT ON TABLE core.swim_length). length_type = 'active' exclut les temps de repos au mur.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.local_date AS "Date", a.name AS "Séance", count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Longueurs actives", avg(l.duration_s) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Durée moy. /longueur (s)", avg(l.total_strokes) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Coups moy. /longueur", avg(l.avg_cadence) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Cadence moyenne" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code JOIN core.swim_length l ON l.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY a.activity_id, a.local_date, a.name ORDER BY a.local_date DESC

panels.title: Répartition des nages
panels.description: Nombre de longueurs actives par swim_stroke (core.swim_length).

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.swim_stroke AS "Nage", count(*) AS "Longueurs" FROM core.swim_length l JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = l.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND l.length_type = 'active' AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY l.swim_stroke ORDER BY count(*) DESC
